title: HF3038 (2017-2018 Regular): Slide-fire stock for a semiautomatic firearm clarified as a trigger activator.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/HF/3038/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version; no vote listed. The saved text does not mark added words; the quoted sentence is the one the title says the bill adds. Rest of subd. 1 (definitions of machine gun, shotgun, etc.) is existing law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 1, para. (d)): For purposes of this section, a device that is designed to use the recoil of a semiautomatic firearm to enable a shooter to fire multiple shots in rapid succession, commonly known as a slide-fire or bump-fire stock, is a trigger activator.
